name: Default
shortDescription: End-to-end encrypted photo and video backup with the Ente server, the Photos web app, public album sharing, PostgreSQL and S3-compatible object storage.

alerts.message: No email server is configured, so sign-up verification codes are printed in the ente-museum service logs. The first account created becomes the admin, so register your own account first.

The API is served on api.<your domain> and public albums on albums.<your domain>; both subdomains must resolve to this server. Point the Ente mobile and desktop apps at https://api.<your domain> as a custom server.
Every account, including the admin, starts with a 10 GB storage limit. Raise it with the Ente CLI (ente admin user update-subscription) logged in as the admin.
